content.title: Meituan, Alibaba Shares Jump as China Seeks to Curb Price Wars
content.summary: Market leader Meituan’s stock rallied 6.6% in Hong Kong, the most since May 29.  Shares of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. — the biggest challenger to Meituan — rose 5.3%, while the company’s US-listed shares extended gains to rally as much as 11%.  “The increased scrutiny on competition will be supportive of industry margins,” said Catherine Lim, an analyst at Bloomberg Intelligence.
